data.title: Stylized Trees and Rocks Kit
data.summary: Free stylized 3D trees, rocks, bushes, grass, ferns and flowers: pines, oaks, birches, palms, boulders and garden props for games.
data.description: A generic stylized prop kit for the queries every outdoor scene needs: pine tree, oak, birch, palm, bush, grass tuft, fern, flower and rock. Forty eight standalone designs (twenty trees and stumps, eight bushes and shrubs, ten ground plants, ten rocks plus a meadow disc) with chunky rounded forms and saturated flat colours at the standard fidelity budget. Every piece rests on y = 0 and dresses any garden, park, forest edge or rock garden in Unity, Godot, Unreal, three.js or Blender. All static meshes: no rig and no animation anywhere in the pack, because a prop kit needs placement, not playback.

Every piece is a standalone prop from the kit.
